name: Farm Supply Simulator 25
detailed_description:
Build your own agricultural supply empire in Farm Supply Simulator 25! Start with a small shop, stock your shelves, and serve farmers with essential goods. Soon, ramp up production with chemical and organic fertilizer machines and establish feed factories to expand your product lineup.

Your production process is fully dynamic: manage raw material sourcing, inventory, and machine efficiency to fulfill orders on time. Create chemical fertilizers from nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium or craft organic alternatives using manure, compost, and worm castings. Feed production ranges from energy mixes to protein supplements, offering dozens of recipes.

The consulting division is the game’s highlight: diagnose plant diseases from samples brought by customers and choose the correct treatment from hundreds of options. In your soil analysis lab, generate detailed reports on pH, organic matter, and mineral content to recommend optimal crops. Accurate diagnoses and advice will boost your reputation and profits.

With a realistic economy featuring banking and loans, assign staff, pay bills on time, and invest in expanding your production line. Day-night cycles, sleep requirements, and multiple save slots let you experiment with different strategies. As you grow, build a seamless logistics network connecting warehouses, storefronts, consulting stations, and labs.

In this strategy-rich, informative simulator for agricultural suppliers, manage everything from your store to your fields, outshine competitors, and rise to the top of the farming world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or better
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or AMD Ryzen 5 2500x
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
